relationships.subject: IGF2BP1
relationships.evidence_quote: RNA immunoprecipitation revealed a close interaction of IGF2BP1 with PTBP1.

relationships.subject: IGF2BP1
relationships.evidence_quote: IGF2BP1 silencing also decreased the expression of PCNA and VEGF, and increased E-cadherin expression in endometrial tissues of EMs rats.

key_findings: IGF2BP1 and PTBP1 are elevated in endometriosis tissue and IGF2BP1 interacts with PTBP1.
IGF2BP1 silencing reduced lesion size and VEGF/PCNA in EMs rats.
